name: Life_Talk_Explain
note: speaker: both hands shape ideas (wide 'the whole thing', a box that grows and shrinks, counting beats)

name: Life_Talk_Emphatic
note: speaker: hand on hip, right hand chops the air three times, leaning into every stroke

name: Life_Talk_Casual
note: speaker: left hand on hip, weight on one leg, right hand gestures loosely (so-so wobble, across the body)

name: Life_Talk_Gossip
note: speaker: leans in, right hand cupped beside the mouth, glances around to check nobody hears; a suppressed giggle

name: Life_Talk_Listen_Nod
note: listener: arms crossed, two clear nod pairs, weight shifts from foot to foot

name: Life_Talk_Listen_Hips
note: listener: hands on hips, head tilts side to side as if weighing it, one nod, weight shifts

name: Life_Social_Laugh
note: one-shot belly laugh: inhale, head back, shoulders shake at 5 Hz, folds forward, wipes the eye, recovers

name: Life_Social_Laugh_Slap
note: one-shot: doubles over laughing and slaps the right knee twice

name: Life_Social_Argue_A
note: aggressor: leaning in, jabbing finger three times per cycle, one stamp of weight, fist clenched at the side

name: Life_Social_Argue_B
note: defender: palms out, head shakes, steps back half a step and forward again

name: Life_Social_Point_Directions
note: one-shot: listens with a thoughtful hand at the chin, then turns and points far off to the right, sweeps the arm along a road, turns back and nods

name: Life_Social_Wave_Greet
note: one-shot friendly wave: the hand comes up beside the head, waves three times with the fingers leading, lowers

name: Life_Social_Wave_Far
note: one-shot big overhead wave for calling across the square: whole arm sweeps, body sways under it

name: Life_Social_Shrug
note: one-shot 'who knows': shoulders up, palms out and up, head tilts, hold, drop with a small rebound

name: Life_Social_Nod
note: one-shot: two clear nods, the second bigger, with a small chest dip

name: Life_Social_Shake_Head
note: one-shot: 'no' - three head swings with a counter-turn of the chest, small shoulder drop at the end

name: Life_Social_Bow
note: one-shot polite bow: right hand to the chest, folds from the hips, holds a beat, rises

name: Life_Social_Hug_A
note: paired hug A: half-step in, arms wrap (right over the partner's left shoulder, left under), head to the partner's right shoulder, two pats, release. Author distance 0.40 m.

name: Life_Social_Hug_B
note: paired hug B: half-step in, arms wrap (right over the partner's left shoulder, left under), head to the partner's right shoulder, two pats, release. Author distance 0.40 m.

name: Life_Social_Handshake_A
note: paired handshake A: right hands meet at ~1.0 m in the middle, two firm pumps, release. Author distance 0.80 m.

name: Life_Social_Handshake_B
note: paired handshake B: right hands meet at ~1.0 m in the middle, two firm pumps, release. Author distance 0.80 m.

name: Life_Social_Mourn_Kneel
note: loop: kneeling on the right knee, face in both hands, shoulders shake with sobs, a slow deep breath every 2 s

name: Life_Social_Mourn_Kneel_Enter
note: drops to the right knee, folds forward and lifts the hands to the face; ends on the first frame of Mourn_Kneel

name: Life_Social_Mourn_Kneel_Exit
note: from Mourn_Kneel: hands drop, pushes up off the knee and stands; ends at neutral

name: Life_Social_Mourn_Stand
note: loop: standing, head bowed, hands clasped low; small sobbing breaths, and now and then the right hand wipes the eyes

name: Life_Kid_Run_Play
note: excited in-place run: flight phase, high knees, arms flailing loosely, body rolling with every stride, head bobbing. speed_mps on the authored skeleton

name: Life_Kid_Chase_Chicken
note: crouched scurrying run, head up on the target, one low two-handed-style grab lunge per arm every second stride

name: Life_Kid_Skip
note: in-place skipping: long-short step-hop rhythm, the free knee lifts high, arms swing wide, head rolls with the beat

name: Life_Kid_Tag_Touch
note: one-shot: coiled crouch, lunge with an outstretched hand (touch at frame 17: partner is ~0.75 m ahead), gleeful recoil, twists away and bolts; back to neutral

name: Life_Kid_Hopscotch
note: one-shot in place: hop, hop on the left foot, straddle-jump landing on both, hop, hop on the right foot, jump turn and land; neutral at both ends

name: Life_Kid_Clap_Jump
note: one-shot: crouch, jump with both arms swinging up to clap overhead at the apex, land bouncy, small second clap of joy

name: Life_Ambient_Look_Around
note: one-shot: the head leads a slow look over the left shoulder, then a longer look to the right, the chest follows a beat late, back to neutral

name: Life_Ambient_Scratch_Head
note: one-shot: right hand up to the back of the head, scratches with a curling hand, head tilts into it, drops and shrugs it off

name: Life_Ambient_Shift_Weight
note: one-shot: sighs, moves the weight onto the left leg while the right foot re-plants wider, holds the cocked hip, and settles back

name: Life_Ambient_Stretch_Morning
note: one-shot: inhales, both arms up with the fingers laced and palms to the sky, back arches and head tips back, side lean, then the arms fall wide and the shoulders roll out

name: Life_Ambient_Yawn
note: one-shot: a big yawn behind the right hand, head tipping back, chest opening, then a sagging exhale and a rub of the eye with the left hand

name: Life_Ambient_Check_Sky
note: one-shot: tips the head back to read the sky, the chest opens, a slow sweep from one side to the other, then back down

name: Life_Ambient_Shade_Eyes
note: one-shot: flat right hand to the brow against the glare, squints along the horizon left to right, drops the hand

name: Life_Ambient_Wipe_Brow
note: one-shot: heavy sigh, right forearm wipes across the forehead, flicks the sweat off the hand, sags and breathes out

name: Life_Ambient_Rub_Arms
note: one-shot: hunches, hugs itself and rubs both upper arms briskly while the body shudders, releases with a shiver

name: Life_Ambient_Glance_L
note: one-shot 1.2 s glance to the left: the head snaps round first, the chest follows a few frames later, hold, and back

name: Life_Ambient_Glance_R
note: one-shot 1.2 s glance to the right: the head snaps round first, the chest follows a few frames later, hold, and back

name: Life_Ambient_Rain_Hunch_Upper
note: upper-body layer over locomotion or idle (spine_01 and up): shoulders up, head down, left forearm held flat above the head as a shield, right hand pulling the collar shut; small shudders

name: Life_Walk_Cane
note: elder walk, bent spine, short shuffling steps, cane in the right hand planted with every LEFT step (tip on the ground from frame 0 to 32, then swings forward). Cane length 0.90 m (measured from cane.glb)
